description: HushPinterest v0.0.10: 29 patches for Pinterest 14.40.0, which needs Android 10 or newer. New in this release: Hide search history also hides the recent searches under the search bar and the Recent searches heading on the search page, and Quick setups can be hidden with a long press. Validation: 946 runtime tests passed. All 221 patch tests passed. All 29 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.40.0. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.
